mapper.select:
SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, ENTRUST_ID id FROM ETR_ENTRUST
AND ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_STATUS IN(#{entrustAwait},#{entrustDistribute},#{entrustReceive},#{entrustUntread},#{entrustClose},#{entrustReturn},#{entrustRecall})
AND ENTRUST_ID like concat(concat('%',#{etrId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')

SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_ABBR text, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT, T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11, to_char(T1.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') MDATE, T1.CCY, null as PRICE FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID

SELECT distinct SYS_USER.USER_NAME id, SYS_USER.REAL_NAME text ,SYS_USER.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM SYS_USER INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE ON SYS_USER.USER_NAME = SYS_USER_ROLE.USER_ID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE ON SYS_USER_ROLE.ROLE_ID = SYS_ROLE.ROLE_ID
AND SYS_ROLE.ROLE_POS IN( #{roleOne}, #{roleTwo} )
AND (SYS_USER.USER_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR SYS_USER.REAL_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))

SELECT distinct T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_ABBR text, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT, T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11, to_char(T1.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') MDATE, T1.CCY, pr.price as PRICE from ptl_sec_position_rule ptl INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY PPA ON ptl.PORTFOLIO_ID = PPA.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND PPA.USER_ID = #{userId}
inner join fin_product T1 on ptl.finprod_id=T1.finprod_id and T1.is_right='Y' inner join FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN p on p.finprod_id=T1.finprod_id and p.finprod_id=ptl.finprod_id left join ( select row_number() over(partition by pd.finprod_id order by pd.exercise_date) idx, pd.finprod_id, pd.exercise_price as price from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN pd where pd.exercise_date>#{platDate} )pr on pr.finprod_id=T1.finprod_id and pr.finprod_id=ptl.finprod_id and pr.idx=1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID where T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{assestType} AND T1.TRADE_MARKET in(#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02}) and T1.is_right='Y' and ptl.cdate=#{platDate} and p.exercise_date>#{platDate} and ptl.amount>0
and (T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) )
mapper.insert: insert into ETR_ENTRUST_OPER_HIS (SEQ_NO, ENTRUST_ID, OPER_TYPE, OPER_DATE, OPER_TIME, BUSI_DES, USER_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) values (#{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operDate,jdbcType=DATE}, sysdate, #{busiDes,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR},sysdate )

SELECT DISTINCT MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID id, MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR text FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO
AND (MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))

select distinct mst.counter_id id,mst.counter_name text from MST_COUNTER_PARTY mst where mst.counter_type in ('01','02')
AND (mst.counter_id like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or mst.counter_name like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
